join_rule: A solicitation PIN of five digits, one letter and four digits (the bid stem) is joined to the award notices whose contract PIN begins with that stem and ends in nothing, a 3-digit contract sequence, or a 3-digit sequence plus a renewal suffix (R and three digits). The award must name the same agency (by the engine's canonical agency id) and be published on or after the solicitation. A solicitation PIN of any other shape is joined only when an award carries exactly the same PIN, the same agency, and a later or equal date. Agencies with no award notices in the window, solicitations with no PIN, PINs of another shape, awards that all predate the solicitation, and awards on the stem under another agency or an unrecognised tail are published as cannot be linked, with the reason. A stem with no award notice yet is published as no award published yet. When several awards join, linked_award is the earliest whose notice date is after the solicitation's printed response due date, and the others are published as other awards on the same contract number. An award dated on the due date is not after it. Dates compare as calendar days. When the City Record printed no response due date, linked_award is the earliest joined award and the due date is left empty. A single joined award is linked_award. Nothing is guessed from titles or vendor names. Award dates are City Record notice dates; amounts are the amount printed in the award notice, not payments.

linked_pin_stem.text: An award notice is published on this solicitation's PIN stem for the same agency.

linked_pin_exact.text: An award notice is published with exactly this solicitation's PIN for the same agency.

no_award_published_yet.text: No award notice is published yet for this PIN. Awards are published some months after the solicitation, so a recent notice may simply be early.

award_before_notice.text: The only award notices on this PIN stem were published before this solicitation, so none is linked.

award_other_agency.text: Award notices exist on this PIN stem under a different agency, so none is linked.

award_pin_tail_unrecognised.text: Award notices exist on this PIN stem with a contract number in a shape the join does not read, so none is linked.

pin_shape_not_joinable.text: This agency's PINs for this kind of notice are not in the bid-stem shape, so the award cannot be matched by PIN.

no_pin.text: This notice published no PIN, so no award can be matched to it.

agency_awards_not_in_city_record.text: This agency's awards are not published in the City Record, so none can be linked from it.
